svg.text: Performance curves over context fill: pick a fill and read down
Claude Opus 5.5 list prices: cache read $0.20, one-hour cache write $8, output $20 per million tokens. One ping every 50 idle
minutes; a fresh start of 171k tokens; 5k tokens added per working turn from a 50k start; a compaction writes a 10k summary into a 50k context.
85%: the hard line, a mid-work wrap
Price of one more turn, or one ping
Input cost of working up to this fill
Turns for a compaction to pay back
starts at 10%: below it, a compaction barely shrinks the context
